en: A black‑and‑white postcard photograph of a wooden roadside shrine or memorial cross standing on a rocky clearing edged by forest. The shrine has a small gabled roof and a carved relief of a figure holding a staff, possibly a pilgrim or saint. Beneath the carving is an inscribed wooden plaque with several lines of text, though the details are hard to read. The landscape behind is hilly and covered with coniferous trees, suggesting a Central European mountain or forest region.
